        "Inspect the regenerated model in the top-right isometric view and all orthographic views. Confirm that the external silhouette corners, saddle transitions, raised landing-pad edges, side-rail edges, underside outer perimeter, and hidden inner opening have all received rounds.",
        "Run geometry validation for self-intersections, zero-thickness regions, collapsed faces, and loss of the underside opening.
